about_short_description.short_description: HockeyStack is the command center for B2B revenue teams that provides modern attribution, unified buyer journeys, and account insights.

product.name: GTM Intelligence
product.description: A revenue intelligence platform that unifies marketing, sales, and revenue data to analyze buyer journeys, attribute pipeline, build reports, and guide go-to-market decisions.

product.name: Marketing Intelligence
product.description: A marketing analytics and attribution solution for measuring campaign impact, connecting marketing activity to pipeline and revenue, and optimizing budget allocation.

product.name: Account Intelligence
product.description: An account-focused revenue intelligence solution that helps sales and go-to-market teams identify engaged accounts, understand buyer activity, prioritize opportunities, and act on pipeline signals.
